text: Ascension is a Catholic, nonprofit healthcare system: its own site describes it as 'one of the leading non-profit and Catholic health systems in the U.S.,' sponsored since 2011 by a Vatican-approved public juridic person representing the founding religious congregations, not by a state or shareholders.

source.name: Ascension: History & Sponsorship
source.quote: Ascension, one of the leading non-profit and Catholic health systems in the U.S., operates approximately 2,600 sites of care in 16 states and the District of Columbia.
